Center the symbol both horizontally and vertically, symbol occupies about 72 percent of canvas with equal transparent margins. Readable at 18 pixels. No tile, no button body, no background rectangle, no colored background, no shadow, no glow, no texture, no grunge, no labels, no watermark. Subject: A simple PLUS sign only: two equal straight perpendicular bars, centered, perfectly balanced.
